INSERT INTO D360.EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB_BU_20241105
SELECT * FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB

--------Patch 1
DELETE A FROM EDS.RIB_CORPORATEUSER A
JOIN
	(SELECT CORP_USER, BANK_ID, SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE, FILE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CORP_USER,BANK_ID ORDER BY FILE_NAME DESC) RN  FROM EDS.RIB_CORPORATEUSER WHERE concat(CORP_USER,BANK_ID) IN (
	SELECT concat(CORP_USER,BANK_ID) CORP_USER FROM EDS.RIB_CORPORATEUSER WHERE SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31'
	group by CORP_USER, BANK_ID
	having count(1)>1) ) B ON A.CORP_USER = B.CORP_USER AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID AND A.SCD_END_DATE = B.SCD_END_DATE AND A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME
WHERE B.RN = 1

--------Patch 2
DELETE A FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB A
JOIN
	(SELECT CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID, CIF_NO, SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE, FILE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID,CIF_NO ORDER BY FILE_NAME DESC) RN  FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB WHERE concat(CIF_NO,CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID) IN (
	SELECT concat(CIF_NO,CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID)  CIF_NO FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB WHERE SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31'
	group by CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID, CIF_NO
	having count(1)>1) ) B ON A.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID = B.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID AND A.CIF_NO = B.CIF_NO AND A.SCD_END_DATE = B.SCD_END_DATE AND A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME
WHERE B.RN=1

--------Patch 3
DELETE A FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB A 
JOIN (
	SELECT CUST_ID, CIF_NO, SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE, FILE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CIF_NO,CUST_ID ORDER BY FILE_NAME DESC) RN FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB WHERE concat(CIF_NO,CUST_ID) IN (
	SELECT concat(CIF_NO,CUST_ID) CIF_NO FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB WHERE SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' AND SCD_START_DATE = '2024-10-24'
	group by CUST_ID, CIF_NO
	having count(1)>1)  ) B ON A.CIF_NO = B.CIF_NO AND A.CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND A.SCD_END_DATE = B.SCD_END_DATE AND A.SCD_START_DATE = B.SCD_START_DATE AND A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME
WHERE B.RN = 1
